channel.title: AI Threat Watch: Deepfake fraud
channel.description: Verified case files in the category Deepfake fraud.

item.title: [LOW] Scammers use AI-generated songs to post fake tracks on real artists' Spotify and other streaming profiles
item.description: A 404 Media report, covered by Engadget and bdnews24, says scammers generate songs with AI tools and use a digital-distribution loophole to publish them as new releases on real artists' profiles on Spotify and other streaming services. The scammers collect the royalties instead of the artists. The band Odette Child says it has tracked the problem since July and found more than 300 such AI-generated songs, and Spotify is developing a release-review tool for artists, still in limited beta. Panda Security later published warning signs for listeners. Target: Real artists' profiles on Spotify and other streaming services. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Primorsky Krai police stop online scam using deepfake technology
item.description: Per Primorsky Krai police, scammers used a deepfake video call of the regional governor, followed by calls from fake law-enforcement and Rosfinmonitoring officers, to pressure a 77-year-old man in Khorolsky district for a month into withdrawing 1 million rubles. He became suspicious and went to police, who swapped the cash for a dummy and detained a 79-year-old St Petersburg woman sent to collect it; no money was lost and a criminal attempted-fraud case was opened. Target: 77-year-old pensioner in Khorolsky district, Primorsky Krai. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Brazilian man sells belongings and travels about 2,000 km to meet AI-generated TikTok 'girlfriend', is left stranded
item.description: Edimar Rocha Martins, a 49-year-old Brazilian bricklayer, sold his belongings and travelled by bus from Maranhão to Belo Horizonte, arriving on 11 October 2026, to meet a woman he knew from the TikTok account @JessicaFazendeira. The account, with about 300,000 followers, turned out to be an AI-generated persona (deepfake video and AI voiceover). Reports say she never asked him for money, and the account's operator said it was run for engagement and monetisation and denied any intention of meeting followers, so no fraud is established. He was left without money, housing or a way home and sought help from Belo Horizonte city social services. Target: Individual follower who believed an AI-generated influencer was real. BR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] SPbU warns of AI deepfakes and fake accounts of Tatyana Chernigovskaya used to sell courses and goods
item.description: St Petersburg State University warned on 30 October 2026 that fake accounts and videos created with AI in the name of academic Tatyana Chernigovskaya were being used to advertise dubious online courses and products. The university said she has no personal social media pages. No losses or perpetrators were reported. Target: Public who trust Tatyana Chernigovskaya; Tatyana Chernigovskaya. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] AI-manipulated video of Antonio Banderas used to sell fake prostate remedy
item.description: A manipulated video in which Antonio Banderas appears to recommend a 'natural substances' prostate product circulated on social media. Maldita.es found the video is not real and that his voice and face were faked, and other Spanish outlets describe it as AI-made. The product's seller and the scale of any losses were not stated. Target: Consumers targeted by fake remedy ads; Antonio Banderas. ES. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI-powered fake lottery tickets fuel mass fraud in Kerala, India
item.description: Kerala Chief Minister V D Satheesan told the state Assembly on 28 October that fraudsters are using AI to produce counterfeit Kerala paper lottery tickets and selling them through social media, sometimes selling the same ticket to several buyers and switching off their phones when a big prize is claimed. He said the practice is especially prevalent in districts such as Palakkad, causes losses to the state exchequer and hurts genuine lottery sellers, and promised stringent action by the Lottery Department and police. No arrests or loss figures are reported. Target: Lottery ticket buyers, genuine lottery sellers and the Kerala state lottery revenue. IN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] AI-generated photo sent to Western Australian man offering reward for missing Irish wolfhound
item.description: After Westyn Ruyter of Balingup, Western Australia offered a $10,000 reward on Facebook for his missing Irish wolfhound Bundy, someone claiming to have found the dog arranged a meeting that nobody attended. When he asked for proof, they sent an image of the dog in a crate that he says is obviously AI-generated; the sender then stopped replying. The ACCC's National Anti-Scam Centre said it was aware that people with missing pets were being targeted. No money loss is reported; the scammer's identity and intent are alleged and unproven. Target: Westyn Ruyter, Balingup WA, who offered a $10,000 reward for his missing Irish wolfhound. AU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] AI-generated 'Xiaohai' boy character with fake hardship stories used to sell products to older Chinese viewers
item.description: Short videos of an AI-generated boy known as 'Xiaohai', who tells fabricated hardship stories and addresses viewers as 'aunties' and 'moms', drew about 600 million views on Chinese short-video platforms. The accounts allegedly exploited older viewers' sympathy to sell products that are often pricier than comparable goods elsewhere. Reports say a 79-year-old was stopped by railway police while travelling to meet the non-existent boy. Several accounts removed sales videos, closed storefronts or were banned, but similar videos continue to appear. Target: Older and middle-aged consumers on Chinese short-video platforms such as Douyin. CN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] DOJ's Operation Ghostbusters: five charged over alleged AI-assisted 'ghost student' federal student aid fraud linked to a Kenyan network
item.description: On Oct 29, 2026 the Justice Department announced indictments and complaints under Operation Ghostbusters against five defendants, plus seizure of more than $750,000 in cryptocurrency. Prosecutors allege criminals used stolen US identities to file fraudulent FAFSA accounts and enrol 'ghost students', with refunds diverted to foreign-controlled accounts via US money mules, including Kenyan nationals. DOJ says fraudsters also use AI to complete coursework to keep the scam going. The allegations are unproven. Target: US federal student aid (FAFSA) programs and colleges. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Argentine woman, 67, transfers 920,000 pesos to scammer posing as her son with an AI-altered photo
item.description: A 67-year-old woman in Argentina transferred 920,000 pesos to a scammer who impersonated her son on WhatsApp and used an AI-altered photo of him to gain her trust. The family spotted the fraud when the messages contained expressions unlike the son's. She filed a complaint with the Cybercrime Department and asked for the recipient bank account to be investigated; the person responsible has not been identified. Target: Individual woman (mother), 67. AR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Shanghai man uses AI-generated video of ill father and fake 'father's death' story to defraud friends of over 1.7M yuan
item.description: Shanghai Putuo police say a man surnamed Jiang borrowed money from friends from 2019 on pretexts including investment, a home purchase and company cash flow. He later claimed his father had cancer and then died, and posted an AI-generated video of his father seriously ill in bed to make the story believable. The total reached over 1.7 million yuan, all of which he reportedly lost in the stock market. He has been criminally detained on suspicion of fraud and the case is under further investigation. Target: Classmates and friends of the suspect. CN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Eaton County Sheriff warns of scam using AI-generated deputy photos and Bitcoin demands
item.description: Eaton County (Michigan) Sheriff Tom Reich warned that scammers call from spoofed local numbers and sometimes send AI-generated images of fake deputies next to cryptocurrency machines to direct victims to deposit money into Bitcoin ATMs. The sheriff's office says deputies never demand payment by phone. Number of victims and losses are not stated. Target: Residents of Eaton County, impersonating sheriff's deputies. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Fake Jagmeet Singh 'arrest' ads on X lead to trading scam targeting Canadians
item.description: AI-generated images and fake news-style ads showing former NDP leader Jagmeet Singh being arrested or handling a duffel bag are reportedly flooding X, with clicks leading to a fake 'AI-powered' trading platform called Groman Pro aimed at Canadians' savings. No victim count or loss figure is stated for this specific campaign. Target: Canadian investors and savers. CA. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Russian Interior Ministry warns scammers are using AI-cloned teachers' voices to extract money and SMS codes from parents
item.description: Russia's Interior Ministry (MVD), as relayed by RIA Novosti, warned that scammers are using neural networks to imitate the voices of class teachers. They phone parents of schoolchildren, invent an urgent problem and ask for money or SMS codes. The MVD's separate figure of 18 deepfake-related fraud cases in 2025 and H1 2026 covers all deepfake fraud and is not specific to teachers. No specific victims or losses are reported. Target: Teachers' voices and the people they contact. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Scammers clone residents' voices with AI to extract money in Jewish Autonomous Oblast
item.description: Per EAO police quoted by regional media, scammers hijacked the messenger and Gosuslugi accounts of a 38-year-old Birobidzhan resident after he clicked a link, then used a neural network to clone his voice and phoned his contacts asking for money. Seven acquaintances were targeted and one transferred 15,000 rubles. Target: Residents of the Jewish Autonomous Oblast and their contacts. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Pakistan's NCCIA says three arrested in Lahore over alleged AI-made fake passports used to open accounts at Canadian banks, with four Indian nationals in Canada also accused
item.description: Pakistan's National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) said on 19 October 2026 that it arrested three Pakistani men in Lahore. It alleges they worked with four Indian nationals living in Canada who made AI-generated fake passports and photos. The documents were allegedly used to open accounts remotely at major Canadian banks, and credit cards were sent to individuals in Canada. The allegations are unproven, no loss figure has been given, and no information has emerged on the status of the four suspects in Canada. Target: Major Canadian banks (account-opening and KYC checks). CA. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Queen Mathilde and Princess Elisabeth of Belgium targeted by AI deepnudes
item.description: A De Standaard investigation reported AI-generated pornographic images and short videos of Queen Mathilde and Crown Princess Elisabeth of Belgium, and also of Flemish Vice-Minister-President Melissa Depraetere and former defence minister Ludivine Dedonder. IBTimes reports the images were discovered on 19 October 2026 and had reportedly been online for days. The Royal Palace has contacted the authorities and platforms to get them removed, and says quick removal is not always easy. Dedonder intends to file a legal complaint. Target: Queen Mathilde, Crown Princess Elisabeth, Melissa Depraetere, Ludivine Dedonder and other Belgian women in public life. BE. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI-generated bomb threats shut down Jackson and Hall County, Georgia schools
item.description: Connected automated robocall bomb threats, which officials said appear to be AI-generated, led to searches of six Jackson County schools and a brief evacuation of Cherokee Bluff High School in Hall County. Searches found no explosives or hazards. The FBI, GBI and GEMA are investigating and assessing whether other districts were targeted. Target: Jackson and Hall County school districts, Georgia. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI scam ads exploit TikTok advertising system to defraud Nigerians
item.description: A Premium Times investigation found AI-generated scam ads, including one impersonating OPay, running as paid promotions on TikTok and targeting Nigerians. The report says one victim, Mohammed Yusuf, a former teacher in Ilorin, Kwara State, submitted his phone number and OPay account details through such an ad. The reporter says scam ads remain prevalent on the platform, and TikTok's removal claims could not be independently confirmed. Target: Nigerian TikTok users and investors. NG. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Pinellas Park woman arrested for allegedly using AI to make fake photos for a motorcycle insurance claim
item.description: Florida's Division of Insurance Fraud says Sevon Tutson, 25, filed a claim with Progressive on April 19 using an AI program called Sidekick. She submitted fake photos allegedly showing her motorcycle was damaged in April and lied to Progressive on a phone call. Progressive later obtained police records showing the crash happened on Feb. 2, when the bike was uninsured. She was booked into Pinellas County Jail on a $5,000 bond. Target: Progressive Insurance (motorcycle damage claim). US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Scammers use deepfake of Murmansk governor Chibis to deceive pensioners
item.description: Murmansk authorities warned that scammers are video-calling elderly residents in messengers and social networks using an AI-generated likeness of Governor Andrey Chibis, reportedly promising help from law-enforcement officers as a trap. No loss figures or victim counts were reported. Target: Pensioners in Murmansk region. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Australian woman who lost nearly A$50,000 to a bank-spoofing text scam finds her interview footage allegedly used in AI scam ads for a fake fraud-recovery service
item.description: Sunni Wan, a Sydney woman who lost almost $50,000 in a 2023 bank-impersonation text-message scam, found footage of her distressed media interview allegedly repurposed in AI-generated Facebook adverts for a fake Interpol recovery service targeting other scam victims. Infoblox attributes the broader campaign to a Russian-speaking actor, which is not independently proven. Meta removed the ads featuring Wan after media reports; Infoblox says others remain live. Target: Sunni Wan (individual) and other fraud victims seeking to recover money. AU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI bots flood 2023 UK government consultation on disposable vapes ban
item.description: A study in Tobacco Control, reported by the Guardian on Oct 27, 2026, found that 90,835 of 118,756 responses to the UK government's 2023 tobacco and vapes consultation were automated, AI-generated submissions, almost all answering one question and opposing the disposable vapes ban. The bots were apparently trying to block the ban. The health department screened them out, and the ban took effect on 1 June 2025. The party behind the bots is unidentified. Target: UK government consultation on tobacco and vapes bill. GB. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Providence health-worker agency allegedly used AI to backdate Medicaid patient records in $2M fraud; seven indicted
item.description: On Oct 22, 2026 Rhode Island's Attorney General announced a 51-count indictment of seven people tied to U'Nique Diversity Innovations, a Providence community health worker agency, over an alleged scheme to defraud Medicaid of about $2 million. Prosecutors allege the owner and another defendant used AI to generate patient notes and treatment records months after the purported services, and that backdated training certificates were also forged. The allegations have not been proven in court. Target: Medicaid program (Rhode Island). US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Alice, Texas store says apparently AI-generated receipt was used to obtain $600+ designer purse refund
item.description: Horseshoes Western Wear in Alice, Texas said a receipt that appeared to be AI-generated was used to obtain a warranty refund of more than $600 on a designer purse. The fake was identified only after the refund was paid. The Better Business Bureau urged businesses to verify receipts before issuing refunds. Target: Horseshoes Western Wear (and its distributor), Alice, Texas. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Chanthaburi police arrest man accused of AI-forged-document romance scam worth 21.29M baht
item.description: Chanthaburi police arrested a Thai man accused of defrauding one romance-scam victim of 21,287,731.88 baht through 623 payments and handovers between April 2025 and September 2026. Police say he used AI tools to generate and alter fake bank documents showing a deposit of over 14 million baht, and most of the money was allegedly spent on online gambling. He faces charges of forgery and fraud. Target: A single romance-scam victim (623 payments over about 17 months). TH. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI-voice bomb threats repeatedly disrupt Wheatland, California schools
item.description: Wheatland Union High School in Yuba County, California, received an overnight bomb threat on 18 August 2026 that police described as computer-generated and officials said used an AI-generated voice; it demanded a $15,000 ransom and led to class cancellations. Threats recurred the next day at the high school and Bear River Middle School, and again on later days. Police searched the campus, found nothing, and called the threats hoaxes; investigators had not identified the caller. Target: Wheatland Union High School and Bear River Middle School, Yuba County, California. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Deepfake of Smolensk governor Vasily Anokhin urges foreign airlines to protect crews over Russian airspace
item.description: A neural-network-generated video circulated online in which Smolensk Oblast governor Vasily Anokhin appeared to urge foreign airlines flying through Russian airspace to look after their crews. Anokhin said in his Max channel that he made no such address and that the video was fake. The creators are unidentified and no financial loss or scam scheme has been reported. Target: Vasily Anokhin, governor of Smolensk Oblast (impersonated); the public. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Russian MVD warns fake online stores may use AI-generated celebrity videos to lure buyers
item.description: Russia's Interior Ministry cybercrime directorate warned on 27 October 2026 that fake online shops advertising steep discounts or foreign delivery may use AI-generated videos of well-known people to look convincing. Buyers are asked to prepay in full and the goods never arrive, with the sellers blaming customs delays and keeping the money. The MVD gave no victim numbers, losses or arrests. Target: Online shoppers. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Jancovici denounces alleged AI-cloned voice used in cold calls selling solar panels and insulation to French residents
item.description: Jean-Marc Jancovici says an AI imitation of his voice is being used in unsolicited commercial calls offering solar panels and insulation works. He says he has received about ten testimonies and is behind none of the calls, and he warns people not to give personal or banking details. An M6 Info clip of one call circulated on 30 October. The caller and the tool used have not been established, and no losses are reported. Target: French residents receiving the calls; Jean-Marc Jancovici (voice allegedly imitated). FR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Dubai café says customer used AI-generated photo to claim delivery refund
item.description: Dubai café Taho Avenue (Al Muraqqabat, Deira) alleges a customer submitted an AI-generated photo of a spilled order to claim a food delivery refund, pointing to mismatched cup sleeves, sago instead of boba and unrealistic spillage; the claim comes from the café's own social media post and has not been independently verified. Target: Taho Avenue café, Dubai (food delivery refund process). AE. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Honduran woman arrested for allegedly using AI-made fake bank-transfer receipts to scam cellphone sellers in San Pedro Sula
item.description: Police in San Pedro Sula arrested a 25-year-old woman in flagrante on 24 October 2026 after a seller reported her. She is accused of sending fake bank-transfer receipts, allegedly made with AI tools including ChatGPT, to sellers of high-end phones on Facebook Marketplace. Preliminary investigation points to AI use, and authorities have not published a forensic finding on which tool was used. The attempted sale was foiled and two phones were seized. Police records list 22 fraud complaints against her since 2022; the total number of victims and the amount are not stated. Target: Sellers of high-end cellphones on Facebook Marketplace in San Pedro Sula. HN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Jon Bon Jovi impersonator uses AI videos to scam woman out of $10K
item.description: A scammer posing as Jon Bon Jovi on Instagram used AI-generated videos over about 10 months to build trust with Louisiana fan Leslie Pickett, then pressed her for bitcoin payments; she lost over $10,000 and says she nearly lost her home. An ethical hacker brought in by the National Geographic 'Super Scam Me' team reportedly traced the impostor to Lagos; this is alleged. Target: Leslie Pickett, a Louisiana woman. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] St Petersburg ballet master Komleva sells flat for 9.1M rubles after calls from AI avatar of Governor Beglov
item.description: Scammers reportedly used an AI avatar of St Petersburg governor Alexander Beglov, plus a man posing as a first deputy interior minister, in messenger video calls to convince Mariinsky Theatre ballet master Gabriela Komleva, 87, to sell her Tsarskoye Selo flat for 9.1M rubles (December 2024) and hand the proceeds to them. She realised the deception months later and went to police; the case became public via a court ruling that let the buyer keep the flat. Target: Gabriela Komleva, 87, Mariinsky Theatre ballet master, St Petersburg. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Martinez, California mother wires $5,400 in fake-kidnapping call using suspected AI-cloned voice of her daughter
item.description: Deborah Del Mastro of Martinez, California says a caller claimed her 37-year-old daughter had been kidnapped by a cartel and played what sounded like her daughter's panicked voice, which she says was AI-cloned. Over about five hours she wired $5,400 to Mexico before confirming her daughter was safe. The AI voice cloning is alleged and the tool used is not identified; Martinez police reportedly investigated. Reported in May 2026 and recirculated in late October. Target: Deborah Del Mastro, Martinez, California. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] 88-year-old BC man loses $450,000 to deepfake video of PM Mark Carney; TD Bank has not repaid him
item.description: CBC Go Public reports Ralph Moore, 88, of Qualicum Beach, BC, lost $450,000 over 10 months to an online investment scam he was drawn into by a deepfake video of Prime Minister Mark Carney; his family says TD Bank has not reimbursed him. Target: Ralph Moore, 88, of Qualicum Beach, British Columbia. CA. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Scammers use AI-cloned voice of Osceola County, Florida sheriff's captain in fake arrest-warrant calls
item.description: The Osceola County Sheriff's Office says scammers used AI to clone the voice, and used the photo, of Captain Steve Moser in voicemails claiming recipients had an arrest warrant or had missed jury duty. The office estimates about 40 cases of scammers impersonating law enforcement this year. The sources report no victim losses and do not say all of the 40 cases involved AI voice cloning. Target: Residents of Osceola County, Florida receiving fake arrest-warrant and missed-jury-duty calls; Captain Steve Moser impersonated. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Tarn restaurateurs scammed with AI-generated bank proof and doctored photo
item.description: According to the Tarn gendarmerie and local press, a scam targeted restaurants around Saint-Sulpice-la-Pointe: a caller claimed a duplicate payment, then a woman showed an AI-retouched bank statement on her phone to demand a cash refund. Gendarmes recorded at least five victims or attempts, and a suspect was arrested and confessed. Target: Restaurants in the Tarn, France. FR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI deepfakes of actress Wu Yue and other celebrities used to push product sales
item.description: Actress Wu Yue said on 18 October 2026 that the WeChat Channels account '花姐美肤日记' (Hua Jie Beauty Diary) used an AI face-swap and cloned voice of her to promote skincare products she never endorsed, and she demanded it repay viewers. Coverage says other public figures, such as Deng Yaping, have been faked in similar sales videos. No loss figure has been reported, and the buyers' losses are alleged. Target: Wu Yue, other impersonated celebrities and the buyers deceived. CN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Seoul police officer indicted for making and spreading deepfake videos of acquaintances
item.description: Busan prosecutors indicted, in detention, a serving Seoul Dongdaemun police officer accused of using an AI app to create about 400 sexually explicit deepfake videos of acquaintances and distributing some of them (about 50, per reports) on Telegram. Prosecutors also charged him over possession of illegal sexual material, including child sexual exploitation material; the case followed a Busan police undercover investigation of a Telegram chat room. Target: Acquaintances of the officer (individuals). KR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Pensioner in Ust-Ilimsk loses 26M rubles to scammers using a 'digital double' of Irkutsk governor Kobzev, officials say
item.description: Governor Igor Kobzev said scammers used his 'digital double' to deceive a pensioner in Ust-Ilimsk, Irkutsk Oblast, who handed over 26 million rubles, nearly all her savings, in late October 2026. Media reports describe a copied voice and a video call, and police say a further 6 million rubles was saved. The AI technique has not been independently verified. Target: Pensioner in Ust-Ilimsk, Irkutsk Oblast, Russia. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Shanghai man loses 180,000+ yuan to AI-image 'fiancée' in ring that took 1.8M yuan from 15 victims
item.description: CCTV News reported that Mr. Liu, who works in Shanghai, transferred more than 180,000 yuan to an online 'fiancée' who turned out to be a fiction built by a fraud ring. Human chat operators followed a seven-day script and sent AI-generated or AI-altered photos, backed by forged medical and ID documents. Minhang police traced the ring and made arrests in Guangdong, Shandong, Guizhou and elsewhere. The ring defrauded 15 victims of more than 1.8 million yuan, and those involved received prison terms of up to 11 years. Target: 15 victims across China, including Mr. Liu of Shanghai. CN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Mendoza retiree loses $24.5M pesos to crypto scam using AI-manipulated Messi and Scaloni video
item.description: A 70-year-old retiree from Las Heras, Mendoza, lost about 24.5 million pesos after a sponsored Facebook post imitating a La Nación article and a video of Lionel Messi manipulated with AI promoted a fake crypto investment platform called 'Stake Manerix 0.6'. The image of coach Lionel Scaloni was also used. Per local media, a judge ordered Ualá and Mercado Pago to suspend loan collections and return $8.2M pesos while the case proceeds. Target: Retired individual in Mendoza, Argentina. AR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] AI sexual deepfakes of female students at Colegio Alicante del Sol, Puente Alto
item.description: Parents allege AI was used to create sexual material of female students in grades 9-12 (primero a cuarto medio) at Colegio Alicante del Sol in Puente Alto, Chile, and that the material circulated among students. Target: Female students at Colegio Alicante del Sol. CL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Fake CEO WhatsApp and cloned lawyer's voice trick Intesa's Fideuram into sending €95M abroad
item.description: In February 2026 Fideuram's chairman received a WhatsApp message posing as Intesa Sanpaolo CEO Carlo Messina, then a call using an AI clone of a law-firm partner's voice; about €95M ($108M) went to accounts abroad. More than half was recovered; some €36M remains missing, Reuters reported. Target: Fideuram, private banking arm of Intesa Sanpaolo. IT. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI-generated presenters in 550+ TikTok videos spread false claims about Singapore and Malaysia
item.description: A CNA investigation found 30 TikTok accounts running more than 550 videos with AI-created or manipulated female presenters; over 98% were AI-generated or altered, nearly 90% carried false or misleading claims about Singapore and Malaysia, and they drew more than 3 million views. TikTok removed two accounts CNA flagged. Target: Singapore and Malaysia audiences on TikTok. SG. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Man sentenced in first US AI music streaming fraud case after $8M in bot-driven royalties
item.description: A North Carolina man got 18 months and must forfeit $8,091,843 after prosecutors said he streamed hundreds of thousands of AI-generated songs via about 10,000 bot accounts to collect royalties; first US AI streaming case Target: Music streaming platforms and royalty pools. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Greek police bust gang that cloned relatives' voices with AI to steal over 1M euros
item.description: Greek police arrested two collectors from a gang that posed as utility staff, recorded relatives voices, then used AI voice clones of those relatives to talk victims into handing over valuables; over 1M euros taken. Target: Elderly residents of Attica. GR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-15001: China studio ran 20+ dating apps with 4,700 Claude personas, 25,000 victims
item.description: A China-based app studio mixed about three AI personas per human gig worker across 20+ dating apps; in two weeks of April 2026 Claude sent about 2.36 million messages to 25,000+ users paying in coins to keep chatting. Target: Users of DORA, DONI, ROMI, LUMA and other dating apps. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Heidelberg police: 75-year-old loses six-figure sum to celebrity deepfake investment video
item.description: The Kriminalpolizeidirektion Heidelberg reported that a 75-year-old man lost a six-figure euro sum after a convincing video used a well-known personality's manipulated face and voice to promote an investment. Target: Pensioner in Mannheim/Heidelberg area. DE. Verification: reported.
